//: AquaFuse GF180 4x4 capacity probe for TTGF26c. This is a process-port feasibility run, not a manufacturing candidate. It deliberately starts from official GF defaults; strict nine-corner limits will be established only after a complete routed artifact exists.

This is the default configuration for Tiny Tapeout projects. It should fit most designs.

If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
ser14: the clock tree of s6c1 (clkbuf_2 trees gave 1.5-2.5 ns slews and 12 ns skew across ~60 gated clocks in s6)
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
ser14: hold margins of s6c1 (DR0110 gate is hold >= 0.10 ns in all nine corners); GRT_ADJUSTMENT 0 as in s6, which routed

ser16-k/l: LibreLane counts any setup slack < 0 with no tolerance; v25 failed on -2 fs at one latch D pin (borrowing: arrival == required, CRPR rounding). Setup violations become warnings; the setup gate is the latch-aware audit (s110_electrical_audit --latch, >= 2.0 ns in 9 corners, DR0110), run on every candidate.

ser20-a1 (2 Nov): ser19-a1 with repair margins 0 % (20 % OOM-killed RepairDesignPostGPL at 14 GiB on the 16 GB runner, all four ser19 runs). Hold checker as a warning so precheck and gl_test run; hold is gated by the nine-corner audit (>= 0.10 ns, DR0110), and this flag does not change the layout.
ser18-a: v25 layout (routed) + CTS latency balancing and dummy loads off via src/pnr.sdc (DR019 energy).
ser19-a1 (2 Nov, DR013 update 11): ser18-a + no delay cells as repair buffers (ss setup -13.19 ns), repair headroom 20/10 %, hold margins 0.15 (gate 0.10).

ser21-r1 (2 Nov, DR013 update 12): the resizer/CTS wire estimate (tech LEF, set_wire_rc avg 0.064 fF/um) is 2.3x below RCX (0.147 nom / 0.169 max fF/um over 2.51 m in ser20-a1), so every repair met the limits on paper and missed them routed (15,463 slew pins at max_ss). Tech LEF caps scaled x2.1 max / x1.85 nom / x1.65 min (same-net GRT->RCX ratio 1.74/1.59/1.46 incl. pins); res = LEF. RCX/signoff unaffected.

ser15-v10..12: no CTS latency-balancing delay buffers. v9 CTS inserted 1,206 (CTS-0036), ~70 ns on the u_b1.iqclk branch, giving -54.8 ns hold / -64 ns setup post-CTS, 6,495 hold buffers (+42% area) and DPL-0036
ser15-m1: detailed routing may use Metal1 (pin access). r1 and s6 routed on Metal2-4 only (Metal1 0 um, Metal5 forbidden), shorts on Metal2 dominated

ser15-v17..19: multi-corner resizer + post-GRT repair/timing (s6 failed DR0110 in all 9 corners on single-corner repair). CTS_CORNERS left unset (all STA corners, max_ss read first) as in v11: 103 delay buffers; v10 CTS_CORNERS listed min_ff first and got 1,206
ser15-v25/26: EMA-store probe WITHOUT cell padding (v22/v23 have padding 1)
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
